sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the combinedShearAndBendingDemand quantity handling. Because demand is compared directly with plasticStrength, constrain every represented demand to a compatible force unit, using the canonical unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN unless the verified contract specifies another compatible force unit. Include the unit requirement in both the applicability/presence check and the comparison query; currently a demand with no unit can satisfy the first query and be compared without unit compatibility. Preserve the existing conditional applicability, ship-to-structuralMember-to-loadCase paths, universal represented-load-case rule without adding existence requirements, magnitude calculation, and tolerance scaled from the expected collapse-load magnitude.
